events.breakdown.the_roadside_repair.tit: It Has Been Making That Noise
events.breakdown.the_roadside_repair.bod: The noise it has been making since yesterday stops being a noise and becomes a smell. You get it onto the verge before it decides for you. The nearest town with anything useful in it is behind you, and the light is going.
events.breakdown.the_roadside_repair.out: It is not elegant and it will not last forever, but it turns over on the third try and you are moving before full dark.
You take the wrong thing off first, and putting it back does not put it back. Three hours on the verge and it runs worse than when you started.
You use the spare, which you had been saving for exactly this and are still annoyed to spend. It goes on in twenty minutes.
He comes out, looks at it for ninety seconds, fixes it in forty minutes, and charges what it is worth. You did not expect that and it improves the whole day.
He looks at the vehicle, then at the road, then at you, and names a number based entirely on the third thing. You pay it because the alternative is walking.
You drive it like it is made of glass, in a low gear, with the window down to listen. It gets you somewhere. It is worse when you arrive.
